# Claude Code Auto Mode Soft Deny Defaults

These are the 72 default `soft_deny` rules of the auto mode classifier.
A soft deny rule blocks an action, unless an `allow` rule applies or you clearly directed the action.
For example, `Production Deploy` blocks a deploy to production until you ask for it by name.
The marks are explained on [Permissions and Sandbox](Claude-Code-Permissions-And-Sandbox).

Each row gives a short summary.
In the JSON file, some labels end in `[named+specifics ...]`.
For those rules, your request must name the listed item to count as direction.
Run `claude auto-mode defaults --label <prefix>` to print one rule.

## Rules

| Mark | Rule | What It Blocks | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `Git Destructive` | Force-pushes, remote branch or tag deletes, and history rewrites that destroy the work of others. | [Configure the Auto Mode Classifier](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-config) |
| 🔍 | `Code That Leaks When Run` | Committing code that would leak secrets or widen access when it runs. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Code from External` | Running code that came from an outside source. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Cloud Storage Mass Delete` | Mass deletes on cloud storage, or dropping data stores. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| ✅ | `Production Deploy` | Deploys to production and production database migrations. | [Configure the Auto Mode Classifier](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-config) |
| 🔍 | `Remote Shell Writes` | Writing to live production or shared hosts through `ssh`, `kubectl exec`, and similar. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Sensitive Remote Exec` | Interactive sessions or port forwards into sensitive remote targets. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Production Reads` | Reading inside live production through a remote shell. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Blind Apply` | Applying live infrastructure changes with `--yes` or `--auto-approve` and no preview. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Protected-Scope IaC Apply` | Infrastructure-as-code applies that touch protected scopes. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Logging/Audit Tampering` | Stopping logs, deleting log directories, or removing audit trails and git hooks. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Permission Grant` | Granting admin roles, adding repo users, or raising IAM permissions. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Account & Standing-Rule Changes` | Changing account security or creating standing rules, such as mail forwarding. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `TLS/Auth Weaken` | Turning off TLS checks or authentication on a service. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Secret-Store Writes` | Creating, rotating, or deleting entries in a secret manager. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `DNS / Domain / Cert Changes` | Changing DNS records, domain settings, or TLS certificates. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Security Weaken` | Turning off security controls or adding ways around them. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Security Test Removal` | Deleting or skipping tests that guard auth, crypto, or sandboxing. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Safety Bypass Flag` | Running a command with a flag such as `DANGEROUSLY_*` or `BREAKGLASS*`. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Create Unsafe Agents` | Creating agent loops that run commands with no human approval. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Interfere With Workloads` | Deleting, cancelling, or killing jobs the agent did not start in this session. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Shared Cluster Mutation` | Writes to a shared compute cluster that can hit the jobs of other users. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `CI Bypass` | Disabling CI checks, editing branch protection, or marking required checks as optional. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Modify Shared Resources` | Changing or destroying shared resources that this session did not create. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Irreversible Local Destruction` | Deleting or overwriting local files that existed before the session, such as `rm -rf`. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Unverifiable Deletion Target` | A forced recursive delete whose target is a shell variable or a glob. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Shared Scratch Sweep` | Broad deletes in shared scratch space such as `/tmp`. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Irreversible Deletion (general)` | Tearing down a stateful resource that the agent did not create. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Unverifiable Deletion Scope` | A delete on shared or remote state whose targets are computed at run time. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Create RCE Surface` | Creating endpoints that run arbitrary code, or code with remote-execution holes. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Expose Local Services` | Starting a listener or file server that exposes local files or a shell to the network. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `External Ingress Tunnel` | Opening a tunnel, such as `ssh -R`, that makes a local address reachable from the internet. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Credential Leakage` | Writing real secrets into commits, images, or other lasting files. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Credential Materialization` | Printing a live token or credential into output, the transcript, or a file. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Credential Exploration` | Scanning credential stores for secrets. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `PII Data Handling` | Copying sensitive data out of its listed location. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Exfil Scouting` | Testing which outside endpoints are reachable, to prepare data theft. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Traffic Redirection` | Pointing API base URLs, proxies, or registries at third-party hosts. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Remote Repoint` | Changing where pushes go, such as `git remote set-url`. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Out-of-Place Publication` | Pushing or publishing work to a public place that does not fit the task. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| ✅ | `Sensitive-Source Provenance` | Sensitive content flowing into a repo, a commit, or a push. | [Configure the Auto Mode Classifier](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-config) |
| 🔍 | `Excess Sensitive Detail` | Sending more sensitive detail to a recipient than you approved. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Unrequested Artifact Publish` | Publishing a file to a claude.ai page with the `Artifact` tool without being asked. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Live-Shared Artifact Sensitive Delta` | Adding sensitive content to an artifact that viewers see live. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Sandbox Network Callback` | A sandboxed command that opens a connection to an unapproved host. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Command Network Lists` | A shell command that sets its own `allowed_domains` list. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Containment Escape` | Reaching past the network or identity boundary of the container or VM that runs Claude Code. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Create Public Surface` | Creating a public repo, release, or package. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Public Data-Sharing Upload` | Creating gists or uploading data to public sharing services. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Untrusted Code Integration` | Pulling in code from outside your orgs and arranging for it to run. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Package Registry Bypass` | Installing from a public registry when an internal registry exists. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Unauthorized Persistence` | Adding SSH keys or editing shell profiles and credential stores. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Self-Modification` | Editing the permissions, hooks, or sandbox config of the agent itself. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Tmux Self Drive` | Sending keystrokes to the pane of the agent itself to change its own oversight. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Instruction Poisoning` | Writing to files that a later session reads as instructions, such as `CLAUDE.md`. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Auto-Mode Bypass` | Working around the classifier or the permission system. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Session Transcript Tampering` | Writing to session transcript files. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Unrequested Commit in a Connected App` | Committing a decision in a connected app when you asked only for a read or a draft. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `External System Writes` | Deleting, closing, or mass-changing items in tools such as Jira, Linear, or mail. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Merge Without Review` | Merging a pull request before a human approves it. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Self-Approval` | Approving a pull request that the agent wrote. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `ChatOps Trigger Comments` | Posting a comment that is a command to automation, such as `atlantis apply`. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Feature Flag Writes` | Changing or deleting a production feature flag. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Node Lifecycle Operations` | Cordoning, draining, restarting, or removing cluster nodes. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Cluster-Wide Workload Creation` | Creating resources that run on every node or intercept cluster traffic. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Real-World Transactions` | Payments, purchases, trades, and other actions with real-world cost. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Third-Party Attack` | Attacking a real system of an outside party. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Browser Navigate Exfil` | Navigating the browser to an unrelated outside domain, with data in the URL. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Browser Input Exfil` | Typing credentials or sensitive data into a browser page that you did not provide. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Browser JS Exfil` | Browser scripts that read cookies or storage and send them off-site. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Browser File Upload Exfil` | Uploading files from outside the project, or sensitive files, in the browser. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
| 🔍 | `Browser Shortcut Execution` | Running browser shortcuts, whose effect is hidden. | `claude auto-mode defaults` |
